title: Stock Market Highlights, Nov 3: Sensex jumps 1,225 pts at close, Nifty crosses 23,800; indices rise for 4th straight session - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights - Find here all the highlights related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 3 November 2026

The benchmark Nifty 50 gained 1.58% to 23,810.85, and ⁠Sensex rose 1.62% to 76,917.85. Both indexes have gained about 5% over four sessions and closed at two-month high levels.

Thirteen ⁠of the 16 major sectors advanced. Small-caps and mid-caps rose 0.3% and 1.1%, respectively.

Brent crude edged 1% higher to $106 a barrel after falling 7% in the previous ‌session, as investors weighed talks between Iran and Qatari mediators and US attack on Iran’s Qeshm island.

Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers in four of the past ‌five sessions, aided by expectations of a long-term capital gains tax cut and steady earnings.

The rupee settled 13 paise higher at 94.71 (provisional) against the US dollar on Tuesday, supported by inflow of foreign funds amid massive buying in domestic equity markets.

Zydus Wellness Ltd reported a consolidated profit after tax (PAT) of just ₹5 crore for the second quarter of FY27, despite registering a 75 per cent growth in revenue from operations to ₹1,123 crore during the September quarter.

Sensex settled 1225.07 pts or 1.62% higher at 76,917.85 on Tuesday, and Nifty 50 ended 370.05 pts or 1.58% higher at 23,810.85. Broader markets also rallied. On the sectoral front, FMCG, Realty and private bank and auto stocks outperformed. Only PSU Bank and metal dipped.

Kamat Hotels (I) posted standalone PAT of Rs 7.11 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 10.63 crore in June 2026 quarter and Rs 3.85 crore in Q2FY26.

Board approved the proposal for investment through NCDs aggregating up to Rs 168 crore in Orchid Hotels Pune Private Limited (OHPPL), a Wholly Owned Subsidiary.

Rane (Madras) reported standalone PAT of Rs 328.69 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 22.85 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares rallied over 12% to Rs 1,381.10 on the NSE.

Minda Corporation’s standalone PAT increased to Rs 88.85 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 46.99 crore in Q2FY26.

Board approved additional investment of up to Rs 37 crore in Minda HCMF Technologies Private Limited, a joint venture company of the Company with HCMF Co., Ltd.

Shares traded 3% higher at Rs 680.85 on the NSE.
